content.title: The Major Marathon Qualifying Times Compared
content.text: How do the qualifying times compare for the seven World Marathon Majors? Here are the qualifying times for the marathons in Tokyo, Boston, London, Sydney, Berlin, Chicago and New York to see how they compare. Important Things To Know About The Marathon Major Qualifying Times The London Marathon’s Good For Age programme is only available for UK residents; all other races allow time qualifiers from around the world. For the London Marathon it is the age you ran the time. For Sydney, Boston, Chicago and New York it’s your age on race day (so, for example, you could run a time as a 44-year-old but be 45 on race day and could use the 45-49 time standard). Chicago allows runners from the age of 16, so the first bracket is 16-34. Berlin and Chicago Marathon offer guaranteed entry if you meet the qualifying standards; all others are non-guaranteed and fastest-first in each bracket. Typically runners need to be several minutes faster than their standard (for example, the 2026 Boston Marathon required 4:34 faster than the times below). Tokyo Marathon is not included below because it has semi-elite entry for just 280 runners and the times required change to allow that set field size . It’s very competitive and much faster than the other majors. More detail is listed below for non-binary runners. Here’s more on when to apply for each Marathon Major. Boston Marathon, Sydney Marathon, Chicago Marathon and New York City Marathon do have non-binary qualifying times for faster runners. These are the same as the women’s time standards. High Performance And Sub-Elite Programmes London Marathon has Championship entry for quicker runners. It’s 2:38 for men and 3:10 for women, and you must be a member of a UK athletics club. Chicago Marathon has its high performance program for fast and sub-elite runners. Tokyo Marathon is only a sub-elite programme. FAQ on Marathon Major Qualifying Times Do you need to be a fast runner to run Boston Marathon?Yes, you need to be a faster runner in your age and gender bracket (see times above) but you can also run the Boston Marathon without having achieved a qualifying time. You can run the Boston Marathon for charity or via a sports tour company. What is the hardest marathon to qualify for?Tokyo Marathon is the hardest to qualify for as it only admits 280 runners on a fastest-first basis. The Berlin Marathon also has very difficult time standards but if you meet those standards you get guaranteed entry into the race. What is the easiest marathon major to qualify for?The Boston Marathon has some of the ‘easiest’ times but runners typically need to be around five minutes faster than the ones listed. For British females, the London Marathon Good For Age is quite lenient. But it’s hard to compare because each race and age and gender categories are based on previous historic performances, so times vary. Is London Marathon Good For Age only for UK residents?
